closure_policy: A tail sampling gate is design readiness, not field validation. It cannot close an affected-person, source-preservation, or material-outcome gap until a privacy-approved sample has been collected, bias risk documented, source passages preserved at an approved level, and only aggregate-safe results are added to the cube.
gate_role: Closure-blocking sampling and preservation gates that convert UI claimant and housing household outcome-tail plans into owner-checkable fieldwork prerequisites without collecting private data in the cube.

TSG-HC-001.closure_blocker: No housing affected-person or material-outcome gap can close from this gate. It only defines the minimum fieldwork and preservation prerequisites for a future privacy-approved household-tail collection.

cohort_requirements.denominator_audit: Representation success cannot stand in for unrepresented, default, informal-exit, or lockout outcomes.
cohort_requirements.minimum_observation_goal: pilot_tail_present; closure_generalization_requires provider/court frame and follow-up

cohort_requirements.denominator_audit: Program capacity failure must remain visible when eligible households did not receive full representation.
Physical displacement can occur before, outside, or after formal court outcomes.
A dismissed or sealed case is not closure if screening, debt, or lost housing opportunity persists.

disqualifiers: only court filings used as denominator
private identifiers stored in the cube
fieldwork_controls: household-safe consent or lawful basis held outside the cube
post-case follow-up after payment, possession, shelter, or re-housing event
TSG-HC-001.gate_label: Housing continuity household outcome-tail sampling gate
TSG-HC-001.next_action: Select a jurisdiction/window and partner protocol, then draft a privacy review, retaliation-risk review, and nonresponse-bias plan before any household tail is collected or summarized.
TSG-HC-001.nonresponse_bias_plan: Before any closure claim, record cohort response rates, provider/court/community frame differences, missingness in follow-up, attrition after displacement, and limits of auxiliary data. Unknown informal-exit denominators must be reported as a live bias risk.
privacy_controls: no addresses or docket numbers in cube
kill switch if household-identifying facts enter package
TSG-HC-001.sampling_frame: Must combine court docket exposure, legal-aid/provider intake, rental-assistance or payment-posting signals, tenant hotline/community organization referrals, shelter or re-housing service signals, and an informal-exit/lockout recruitment route. Court filings or represented cases alone are not a sampling frame.
source_preservation_controls: store only short anchors and paraphrases in cube
record no-capture rationale for live dashboards or changing pages
TSG-HC-001.target_population: Households facing arrears, notice, filing, default, representation triage, informal exit, lockout, shelter entry, re-housing, or screening aftereffect during a defined jurisdiction/window.

TSG-UI-001.closure_blocker: No UI affected-person or material-outcome gap can close from this gate. It only defines the minimum fieldwork and preservation prerequisites for a future privacy-approved claimant-tail collection.

cohort_requirements.denominator_audit: Do not use this cohort to represent held, overpaid, appealed, abandoned, or non-user routes.
cohort_requirements.minimum_observation_goal: pilot_tail_present; closure_generalization_requires_owner-approved sample size and response-rate justification

cohort_requirements.denominator_audit: Identity, fraud-control, and document-friction holds must remain visible even if the claim is later paid.
cohort_requirements.minimum_observation_goal: pilot_tail_present; closure_generalization_requires issue-state and hold-resolution frame

cohort_requirements.denominator_audit: A corrected monetary determination is not closure if collection, offset, or hardship persists.
Non-users cannot be inferred from completed claims, survey responders, or portal analytics alone.
cohort_requirements.minimum_observation_goal: pilot_tail_present; closure_generalization_requires non-user recruitment and exclusion report

disqualifiers: only completed or paid claims sampled
private identifiers stored in the cube
fieldwork_controls: consent or lawful-basis record held outside the cube
follow-up after cure, not only after filing
TSG-UI-001.gate_label: Unemployment insurance claimant outcome-tail sampling gate
TSG-UI-001.next_action: Select an owner-approved jurisdiction/window and draft a privacy review plus nonresponse-bias plan before collecting or summarizing any claimant tail.
TSG-UI-001.nonresponse_bias_plan: Before any closure claim, record expected response rates by cohort, actual response rates, auxiliary data available for nonresponse analysis, missingness by key outcome field, and mitigation limits. Below-threshold or unknown response requires an explicit nonresponse-bias caveat.
privacy_controls: cell suppression or narrative redaction for small cells
kill switch if PII enters package
TSG-UI-001.sampling_frame: Must combine agency claim/issue states, survey or observation follow-up consent, legal-aid or community navigator referrals, field-office assisted access, overpayment/appeal records, and a documented non-user recruitment route. A claimant-visible portal population alone is not a sampling frame.
source_preservation_controls: store only short anchors and paraphrases in cube
record no-capture rationale for live web pages
TSG-UI-001.target_population: People who attempted to obtain unemployment benefits through filing, certification, issue-resolution, overpayment/waiver/appeal, staff-assisted, or abandoned/non-user routes during a defined window.

privacy_posture: This file contains only sampling frames, cohort gates, fieldwork controls, preservation controls, and closure blockers. It must not contain names, claim numbers, docket numbers, addresses, account IDs, private screenshots, or partner-held case records.
